question.text:
The energies of energy levels $\mathrm{A}, \mathrm{B}$ and $\mathrm{C}$ for a given atom are in the sequence $\mathrm{E}_{\mathrm{A}}<\mathrm{E}_{\mathrm{B}}<\mathrm{E}_{\mathrm{C}}$. If
the radiations of wavelengths $\lambda_{1}, \lambda_{2}$ and $\lambda_{3}$ are emitted due to the atomic transitions $\mathrm{C}$ to $\mathrm{B}, \mathrm{B}$ to A and $C$ to A respectively then which of the following relations is correct?
